lines: — DAY 90 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
Overnight, Blackberry went bad — beyond saving. You leave it for the flies.
Fresh food keeps days, not weeks. Smoke it over a fire to make it last.
On the carcass nearby, Ugly-Eyes (carcass) went bad — maggots, smell, the whole sad story. Leaving it had a cost.
🎁 You find a small bundle tucked where you'll find it. No one saw it left there.
"The System flagged your sector. Move. NOW."
(390 kcal of dried meat and clean water. Nothing traceable.)
"A message board post, quickly deleted: 'stay away from the northern treeline for a while. trust me.' — the System claims it saw nothing."
◈ THE TABLE IS SET. A ring of pale light waits — take your seat from Haven when you are ready. Nothing is final until you sit.
🏃 Ibrahim of Ashford walks into Haven unannounced, pack-mules behind. "Heard your bins are echoing. Ashford has grain to spare — 1,509 kcal, no tribute, no ceremony. Say the word."
(Aid offer — accept or refuse from the beats row. Refusing costs pride: trust -3.)
You wake with a start — something is wrong.
The village is rattled. Everyone's jumpy — eyes on the treeline.
⚔ THE LOUD BEAST! James joins you!
You fling a handful of grit into its eyes. (pocket_sand: blinded)
Turn-based now. Tap a tile to move — speed is squares. Then act.
James doesn't look away. "About time someone fought back."
COMBAT! THE LOUD BEAST! The gamblers lean in. ROUND 1 — FIGHT!
James's turn
⬛ The Loud Beast's turn
Its white edge-handles grab toward your Phase blade — POINTING. Whatever it points at goes quiet. The handles ARE the telegraph. (Redaction lands next round.)
The Loud Beast stalks closer. Its white edge-handles grab toward you — pointing. Whatever it points at goes quiet. The handles ARE the telegraph.
ROUND 2!
James's turn
⬛ The Loud Beast's turn
A doorway-shaped hole in the world, drifting closer.
A doorway-shaped hole in the world, drifting closer.
The handles close around your Phase blade — REDACTED. For two rounds it is just a shape in your hands. (Strikes are unarmed.)
ROUND 3!
James's turn
James strikes the Loud Beast.
It's reeling — the party sees the opening and piles on! (+25% vs controlled)
James hits redactor for 16.
The bar glitches — a frame of the world shows through the black.
⬛ The Loud Beast's turn
Too close. The redactor's attention SNAPS to you — proximity overrules patience.
redactor's Return swipes at sand-ghosts. Missed. (pocket_sand)
The bar thins, flickers — nothing left loud enough to redact. It is STARVING. (Its attacks weaken; starve it one more turn and it flees.)
(redactor's hide absorbs 5.)
OVERCHARGED ×1.25 (well-fed): food is fuel.
You STRIKE the redactor for 18.
📺 +5 style — solid hit
ROUND 4!
James's turn
James strikes the Loud Beast.
Your Phase blade un-redacts — the word comes back.
James hits redactor for 14.
The bar glitches — a frame of the world shows through the black.
⬛ The Loud Beast's turn
Too close. The redactor's attention SNAPS to you — proximity overrules patience.
Its white edge-handles grab toward your last turn — POINTING. Whatever it points at goes quiet. The handles ARE the telegraph. (Redaction lands next round.)
redactor's Redact swipes at sand-ghosts. Missed. (pocket_sand)
📖 Codex: Redact — locks onto one target — moving won't dodge it. You won't forget this.
The bar steadies — it found something loud to redact. (No longer starving.)
(redactor's hide absorbs 5.)
OVERCHARGED ×1.25 (well-fed): food is fuel.
You STRIKE the redactor for 101 (Phase blade).
📺 +5 style — solid hit
ROUND 5!
James's turn
James strikes the Loud Beast.
James hits redactor for 10.
redactor is BLEEDING — and it likes it. Louder, faster, no more feints.
The bar glitches — a frame of the world shows through the black.
⬛ The Loud Beast's turn
Too close. The redactor's attention SNAPS to you — proximity overrules patience.
The Redactor redacts your last turn — the wound on redactor un-writes itself. It never happened. (+18 HP)
💥 redactor's Redact finds you — no dodging it.
Armor absorbs 27.
James shouts: "Move! MOVE!"
Redactor's Redact hits you for 15.
(redactor's hide absorbs 5.)
OVERCHARGED ×1.25 (well-fed): food is fuel.
You STRIKE the redactor for 99 (Phase blade).
📺 +5 style — solid hit
ROUND 6!
James's turn
James strikes the Loud Beast.
James hits redactor for 13.
The bar glitches — a frame of the world shows through the black.
⬛ The Loud Beast's turn
Too close. The redactor's attention SNAPS to you — proximity overrules patience.
💥 redactor's Redact finds you — no dodging it.
You slip aside — it misses clean. (footwork)
The Loud Beast breaks and runs!
It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.
It RAN! Style score: 15. The gamblers wanted blood, but they'll settle for drama.
No risky water to boil.
Drank clean water.
📋 James — 💧 Fetch water. James nods eagerly. They'll report back by next part.

◈ THE TABLE — it is not a table. It's a ring of pale light, and around it, things with too many angles to be faces. Above it all — the audience. Trillions of eyes, and every one of them knows your name. The System speaks, and for once it isn't performing: "HUMANITY PRESENTS ITS CASE."

◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (14/7/6), 11 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices.
EVERYONE. SIT. WATCH. The teeth and the weather can WAIT — nothing out there matters until this is done. ...Did I stutter? SIT.
James has opinions about the firewood situation and needs you to hear them.
💧 James returns with 12L of creek water. Risky until the hearth boils it.
🩹 Farid is hurting (67 HP) — You patch them up before they head out. (67 → 92 HP)
Farid heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself."
Caleb heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself."
Ingrid is mending something by the door — patient work.
Iron cold. Even the ticks are shelved.
— MIDDAY — Honest work hours. Heat builds.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
📋 James — 💧 Fetch water. James nods eagerly. They'll report back by next part.
💧 James returns with 13L, but the cistern only holds 5L more.
💬 Bekzat says: "Do you ever feel it? Like the air leans in when something happens."
🚶 Wanjiru is back — found Chantal.
🩹 Taha is hurting (68 HP) — You patch them up before they head out. (68 → 93 HP)
Taha sets out to find Chantal. "Won't be long."
Tariq sets out to find Chantal. "Won't be long."
🚶 Bekzat is back — found Chantal.
Bekzat is patching a seam with a scrap of cloth, knot after careful knot.
— DUSK — Animals stir again. Shadows lengthen.
The door is quiet. Haven breathes.
🛟 Ingrid stands up by the fire. "We can't just watch this happen. Here's what we CAN do — pick one, maybe two, but everything costs something."
"We can bind the wounds, or go lean, or hunt hard to replace what we lost. Say which — standing here isn't an answer."
"Or we rally," Ingrid adds. "Second shift, everybody. We work, we eat, we live — and we pay for it."
(Relief is open — triage, rations, hunt, or rally, from the beats row. Each option works once; the moment passes in ~3 days.)
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
"Can't sleep," James admits, sitting near you. "Tell me something from before. Anything."
💧 Farid returns with water: +3 clean.
